subject: Trading Holidays for the Calendar Year 2026 (Partial Modification to NSE/CMTR/71775)
amendment_note: Partial modification to NSE/CMTR/71775 (Ref 172/2025). Confirms 2026-01-15 as trading holiday on account of Municipal Corporation Election - Maharashtra, originally listed in 71775.
